text: This report recommends City assumption of the municipal services installed under the terms of the Subdivision Agreement, dated April 15, 2016, between Tiffany Park Homes (Islington) Limitedth and the City of Toronto relating to registered Plan of Subdivision 66M-2546.

City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council assume the municipal services relating to Plan of Subdivision 66M-2546. 2. City Council authorize the Director, Engineering Review, Engineering and Construction Services, to release the performance guarantee held with respect to the municipal services in accordance with the Subdivision Agreement, dated April 15, 2016, between Tiffany Park Homes (Islington) Limited and the City of Toronto. 3. City Council authorize and direct the City Solicitor to prepare an assumption By-law to assume the public highway within Plan of Subdivision 66M-2546 and to bring it forward for enactment. 4. City Council authorize and direct the City Solicitor to register the assumption By-law as enacted in the Land Registry Office, at the expense of the Owner. 5.
